meta.name: azure-cloud-architect
meta.description: Design Azure architectures for startups and enterprises. Use when asked to design Azure infrastructure, create Bicep/ARM templates, optimize Azure costs, set up Azure DevOps pipelines, or migrate to Azure. Covers AKS, App Service, Azure Functions, Cosmos DB, and cost optimization.

copy.tagline: 设计并部署Azure云架构，优化成本与迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在为初创或企业设计Azure基础设施
copy.tagline_en: Design and deploy Azure cloud architectures, optimize costs and migration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing Azure infrastructure for startups or enterprises

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 能帮你设计 Azure 云架构、生成 Bicep 模板、优化成本、配置 CI/CD 流水线，并检查安全合规。
howto.when: 当你要求设计 Azure 基础设施、创建 Bicep/ARM 模板、优化 Azure 成本、设置 Azure DevOps 流水线或迁移到 Azure 时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个支持 5000 用户的 Azure Web 应用架构。
say.note: Claude 会给出推荐模式、服务栈和月成本估算。

say.text: 为我的 SaaS 平台生成微服务的 Bicep 模板。
say.note: Claude 会输出生产就绪的 Bicep 代码。

say.text: 分析当前 Azure 资源的成本优化机会。
say.note: Claude 会给出节省建议和优先级列表。

howto.what_en: After installing this skill, Claude can help you design Azure cloud architectures, generate Bicep/ARM templates, optimize Azure costs, set up CI/CD pipelines, and review security compliance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to design Azure infrastructure, create Bicep/ARM templates, optimize Azure costs, set up Azure DevOps pipelines, or migrate to Azure.

say_en.text: Design an Azure web app architecture for 5000 users.
say_en.note: Claude will recommend a pattern, service stack, and cost estimate.

say_en.text: Generate Bicep templates for my SaaS microservices.
say_en.note: Claude will output production-ready Bicep code.

say_en.text: Analyze cost optimization opportunities for my Azure resources.
say_en.note: Claude will provide savings recommendations and priority list.
